title: Convergence Gateway: map company OKRs to value-stream initiatives and cross-team commitment protocol
creator: Owen Grant
description:
Problem: As Redwood scales, company-level OKRs increasingly fail to translate into predictable, measurable work at the value-stream level. Teams report ambiguity on which initiatives count toward which company objectives; overlapping ownership and mismatched rollouts create churn.

Goal: Define and pilot a repeatable mapping process (the Convergence Gateway) that converts company OKRs into prioritized value-stream initiatives with clear commitment protocols, decision slices, and gating criteria. The Gateway should be usable during cycle planning and for mid-cycle adjustments, and should produce artifacts teams can act on (initiative charters, owner commitments, roll-forward/backstop rules).

Scope: This ticket covers design, pilot, and rollout of the Convergence Gateway (policy + lightweight tooling + templates) for 3 value streams (Serving Runtime, Console, and Dedicated). It does not include full org-wide automation; that is follow-on work.

Acceptance criteria:
- A documented Convergence Gateway playbook (pdf/link) with mapping steps, roles, and gating checklist created and reviewed by PM, Eng leads, and Design.
- Initiative charter template populated for pilot initiatives (3) with owners, success metrics, risks, dependencies, and rollout window.
- Commitment protocol defined: explicit owner sign-off, resource allocation pledge, and rollback criteria.
- Pilot run completed across Serving Runtime, Console, and Dedicated with retro notes and 3 concrete process adjustments.
- Dashboard slice (roadmap view) that shows OKR->initiative mapping for the pilot value streams.

Work plan (high level):
1) Week 1-2: Interview stakeholders (value stream PMs, Eng leads, Design, GTM) and gather pain points + existing mapping heuristics.
2) Week 3: Draft playbook and templates; align on gating criteria and sign-off flows.
3) Week 4-6: Pilot with 3 value streams; collect artifacts and track metrics (on-time delivery, clarity score from team surveys).
4) Week 7: Retro and process adjustments.
5) Week 8-10: Prepare rollout plan for Q2 cycle and light training for PMs/EMs.

Notes and decisions so far:
- Decided to keep gating light: three binary gates (Scope clarity, Resource pledge, Rollout readiness) to avoid heavy paperwork.
- Will reuse existing Confluence space and add a 'Convergence Gateway' section rather than building new tooling in Q2.
- Dashboard prototype will be a filtered view in roadmap-2026 in the product console; ENG-20412 provides the underlying API hooks.
- Security review not required for process work; tooling changes will be re-assessed in follow-on tickets.

Open risks and unknowns:
- Cross-team incentives: teams may under-report risks to preserve velocity. Need to pair with leadership communications.
- Resource contention if multiple value streams pledge for the same scarce infra (GPUs). ENG dependency (ENG-20412) needs prioritization alignment.
- Measuring impact: selecting the right 'clarity' and 'delivery predictability' metrics is non-trivial.
